# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Report security vulnerabilities by email to security@leanmuscle.club. Do not open a public issue, pull request or discussion for a vulnerability.

Include the affected component (iOS app, Android app, website or server), the steps to reproduce, and the impact. Do not include real user data in the report.

We acknowledge reports within 5 business days.

# 安全策略

## 报告安全漏洞

发现安全漏洞时，发邮件到 security@leanmuscle.club。不要通过公开的 Issue、Pull Request 或 Discussion 报告漏洞。

报告中写明受影响的部分（iOS App、Android App、网站或服务端）、复现步骤和影响。报告中不要包含真实用户的数据。

我们会在 5 个工作日内确认收到报告。
